$comment: The PI rows of spec 00024 §6.B (project 00024-02): which rows of deployments/reference-set.json this repository generates as public-interface-only contracts, the base each is built on, and where its bundle is served. scripts/generate-pi-contracts.ts reads it (with reference-set.json) and writes contracts/generated/<ID>.compact and deployments/generated-matrix.json. Every PI contract: the emitter secret (constructor stores its hash; every emitting circuit checks it), `publishBundle(payload)` behind the secret, and ONE kind of MIP-0018 declaration only — `repository` (the URL of its own source on `main`), one per token (CNSTPI: one per piece). Its interface is FULL: the whole contract source is the published interface (the public-interface open form), so the contract exports impure circuits only (spec Q9: pure circuits cannot be verified). Bundle URLs are `bundleBase` + `bundlePath` + `index.json`; `bundleBase` is the local stack's static server as the compose network names it (`http://bundles/`, resources/00024-local-stack) — a bundle's bytes (its README) depend on its URL, so the URL is fixed here, not at deploy time. UPROMPI's path is long on purpose: its index.json URL is longer than the 224 bytes one `publishBundle` event holds, so its pointer is a 2-part Multi-Part Event package published in ONE guaranteed intent (spec FR-019, sub-plan 02-B3).

rows.covers: open form on a ledger token (OpenZeppelin FungibleToken)
open form on a native shielded token (OpenZeppelin NativeShieldedToken)
open form on a collection: one address, one domain separator per piece (OpenZeppelin NativeShieldedTokenFamily)

open form on a native unshielded token (own template: OpenZeppelin has no native unshielded module); its index.json URL is longer than 224 bytes, so its pointer is a 2-part publishBundle package in one guaranteed intent
